abort.already_configured: This Remeha Home account is already set up
abort.wrong_account: Log in with the Remeha Home account that was set up before. To switch to another account, delete the integration and add it again.

auth.description: Setup the Remeha Home integration using your Remeha Home credentials.

reauth_confirm.description: Failed to refresh the Remeha Home access token. Please re-authenticate with your Remeha Home credentials to continue using this integration.

set_temperature_while_off.message: Cannot set a temperature while the zone is in frost protection. Change the HVAC mode first, or pass `hvac_mode` together with the temperature.

boost_requires_schedule.message: Boost can only be started while the hot water zone is in Schedule mode.

eco_setpoint_requires_tank.message: The Eco temperature can only be changed for a hot water tank. A combi boiler doesn't keep water warm in Eco, so there is no temperature to set.

holiday_end_before_start.message: The end date must be after the start date.

holiday_end_in_past.message: The end date must be after today.

holiday_mode_wrong_entity.message: {entity_id} is not a holiday mode sensor. Choose the Holiday Mode sensor of the appliance.

holiday_request_rejected.message: Remeha Home rejected the holiday mode request ({status}): {message}

temporary_override_not_supported.message: {entity_id} doesn't support a temporary temperature with an end time.

temporary_override_requires_auto.message: A temporary temperature only works while {entity_id} follows the clock program. Set the zone to auto first.

temperature_out_of_range.message: {temperature} °C is outside the range of the zone ({min_temp} to {max_temp} °C).

heating_curve_unavailable.message: The heating curve can't be changed now, because Remeha didn't report its values or limits. Try again after the next update.

set_holiday_mode.name: Set holiday mode
set_holiday_mode.description: Schedule holiday mode for the appliance. Remeha Home keeps whole days only; the appliance lowers heating and hot water to its holiday setpoints in this period.

cancel_holiday_mode.name: Cancel holiday mode
cancel_holiday_mode.description: Stop an active holiday mode or remove a scheduled one.

get_energy_history.name: Get energy history
get_energy_history.description: Retrieve Remeha's indicative daily energy estimates for the selected appliance. This read-only action returns data without creating entities or changing your heating settings. Up to 366 days per request.

device_id.name: Remeha device
device_id.description: Choose the Remeha appliance or its heat-pump/boiler device.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: First calendar day to retrieve (inclusive), before today.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Last calendar day to retrieve (inclusive). Today isn't complete yet, so the period ends yesterday at the latest.

set_temporary_override.name: Set temporary temperature
set_temporary_override.description: Override the clock program of the zone with another temperature for a while. Afterwards the appliance returns to the clock program by itself, also when Home Assistant isn't running. The zone must be in auto mode.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Temperature to hold during the override.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to hold the temperature, from 1 minute up to 7 days.
